notes.title: Aggi's Tiny Friends - Googly Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517371/8ecb34cc8d2f2fe313928a97ee0ac3404a1fc880.png"]

The first small update for Aggi's Tiny Friends is out now! Adding more variety to your creations with a ton of new googly eye designs which is determined by the design of your cell!


[previewyoutube="r_SFdNVTl58;full"][/previewyoutube]


This is hopefully going to be the first of many updates, but unless this game gets a lot more sales, the development of this project will remain as a hobby for me so new updates may be slow.



Follow me on Bluesky for updates on all my games: https://bsky.app/profile/autumnlavender.bsky.social

Thanks everyone so much for playing!
